backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for various frontend files describing styling, layout, and component functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and theme tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app entry point into a root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Composes the main marketing page structure with header, hero, purpose, offerings, and footer sections.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer with brand info, navigation links, contact details, and social icons.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Header: Responsive header with scroll-based styling, navigation links, CTA button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/marketing/HeroSe: Hero section with background illustration, headline, subtext, CTAs, and performance stats.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Offeri: Renders a marketing section listing product offerings with icons, descriptions, and badges in a responsive card grid.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Purpos: Displays a purpose and mission section with three feature cards and a mission statement for the product.
frontend/src/components/marketing/scroll: Provides a helper function to smoothly scroll to a page section with header offset.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on the user’s Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity auth context and provider, handling login, identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with custom color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider, rendering the root component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugin integration.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state and requirements for building the DrawdownKing marketing website, including features, image needs, and pending requests. Contains metadata like schema version, project version, and existing feature definitions.
